origins.neoorigins.human.name: Aadane
origins.neoorigins.human.description: Bani'aadam joogto ah, oo aan lahayn awood gaar ah laakiin awoodo si fiican u dhisan.
origins.neoorigins.merling.name: Isku milmay
origins.neoorigins.merling.description: Dadka biyaha leh ee ku dhashay badda bannaan - waxay u neefsadaan biyaha oo si dhib yar ayay u dabbaalaan, laakiin aayar oo ku engegaan dhul engegan.
origins.neoorigins.avian.name: Avian
origins.neoorigins.avian.description: Duuliyaha quruxda badan oo si tartiib ah hoos ugu dhaadhacaya, oo aan ka baqayn meel sare, oo dunida kor ka daawanaysa.
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.name: ololaya
origins.neoorigins.blazeling.description: Wuxuu ka dhashay dabka hoose - oo lagu qiyaaso baaruud, dib loo soo celiyay mugdiga mugdiga ah, laakiin lagu sumeeyay biyo iyo roob.
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.name: Elytrian
origins.neoorigins.elytrian.description: Khabiir duullimaad saafi ah - ayaa cirka ku shareeray, lama taabtaan xoogaga dhaqdhaqaaqa, laakiin qaab jilicsan oo aan awood u lahayn qaadista hubka culus.
origins.neoorigins.enderian.name: Enderiyaan
origins.neoorigins.enderian.description: Wuxuu ku dhashay jasiiradaha ka baxsan dhamaadka - teleports sida ay rabaan, waxay soo saartaa madaalada bannaan, oo waxay ku socotaa iyada oo aan la arki karin endermen.Biyuhu waxay u gubaan sida aashitada oo kale.
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.name: Arachnid
origins.neoorigins.arachnid.description: Caaro-caaro-caaro-caaro ah oo miisaama gidaar kasta, oo shabkada ku tuura cadawga, oo ku garaaca fangaska - qaraabo la ah gurguurta siddeedda lugood ee adduunka.
origins.neoorigins.shulk.name: Shulk
origins.neoorigins.shulk.description: U gaashaaman sida shulker - waa uu ka rujiyaa dharbaaxada, wuxuu ku noqdaa qolof marka gees la galiyo, oo wuxuu u soo qaadaa cadawga cirka u socda iyadoo levitation dilaacday.Qunyar, laakiin aan la gilgilan karin.
origins.neoorigins.phantom.name: Khayaali
origins.neoorigins.phantom.description: Muuqaal muuqaal ah - oo habeenkii oo dhan ku dul wareegaya baalasha elytra, oo xoog ka soo jiidanaya wax dila, laakiin gubanaya iftiinka qorraxda oo aan awoodin inuu nasto.
power.neoorigins.merling_water_breathing: Neefsashada biyaha hoostooda si aan xad lahayn oo si cad wax uga dhex arkaya biyaha iyada oo aan ceeryaamo lahayn.
power.neoorigins.merling_aquatic_speed.d: Dhaqso u dhaqaaqa marka aad dabaalanayso.
power.neoorigins.merling_night_vision.de: Waxa uu si cad u arkaa moolka mugdiga ah.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.name: Wuu qallalaa
power.neoorigins.merling_dries_out.descr: Hawadu way soo dhacaysaa marka aad biyo ka maqan tahay: oogada aad bay u dheer tahay oo waad ku neef qabataa.Roobka, digsi-biyoodka, Neefsashada biyaha ama marin-biyoodka firfircoon ee u dhow ayaa dhammaan demiya.
power.neoorigins.avian_no_fall_damage.de: Wax khasaare ah kama soo gaadho dhicista - baalalku waxay qabtaan dabaysha.
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.name: Qunyar Dhacda
power.neoorigins.avian_slow_fall.descrip: La beddeli karo: si tartiib ah hoos ayuu u socdaa.Naafo si caadi ahFiiro gaar ah: Hityada muhiimka ah waxay u baahan yihiin hoos u dhac caadi ah, markaa ka ilaali tan si aad u dhaleecayso.
Wuxuu isticmaalaa 75% tamar ka yar dhammaan ficillada.
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.name: Aragti fiican
power.neoorigins.avian_keen_sight.descri: Indho afaysan - wax yar ka roon mugdiga wax ku arag.
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.name: Lafo madhan
power.neoorigins.avian_hollow_bones.desc: -1 wadnaha (-2 max HP).Jidh khafiif ah, jir jilicsan.
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.name: Baal Hop
power.neoorigins.avian_feather_hop.descr: Flutter- kor ula bood baal degdeg ah.Qarash gaajo malaha.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_fire_immunity: Ka difaaca dabka, lava, magma, iyo gubashada - dabka ku dhex jira ayaa ka jawaaba dabka la'aanteed.
+3 wadne (+6 max HP).Taarikada baaruuddu waxay adkeeyaan jirka.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_nether_born.d: Degdegta guriga - si dhaqsiyo leh ayey u socotaa inta Nether-ka ku sugan tahay (wax muuqda oo muuqda ma jiro).
power.neoorigins.blazeling_stone_fists.d: Gacmo qaawan oo aan gacmaheyga ku qabo xagga tier-dhagaxa-dhagax-dhagax-dhagax jebin, macdano, iyo shaag la'aan qalab la'aan.
power.neoorigins.blazeling_internal_heat: Dabka gudaha ayaa kuleyl u guba - gaajo ayaa 25% dhaqsiyo badan u daadisaa.
Biyuhu waa sun - waxay qaadataa 1.5 waxyeello ilbiriqsikii marka ay ku jiraan biyaha ama roobka.
Indhaha lagu hagaajiyay infrared - si cad u arag mugdiga.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.name: Dab-damis
power.neoorigins.blazeling_firebolt.desc: Kubad yar oo dab-damis ah u tuur jihada aad eegayso.Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 tamar4-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_elytra_boost.d: Wuxuu helayaa xawli badan marka lagu bilaabayo elytra.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.name: Duulimaadka Dabiiciga ah
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight.descrip: U lul sida isticmaale elytra - shay looma baahna.Riix bood markaad u dhacayso si aad u kala bixiso baalashaada.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_flight_speed.d: + 30% xawaaraha duulimaadka - cirku kugu soo foorarsado.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_fall.name: Dhirta baalasha
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_kinetic.des: Ka difaaca dhaawaca elytra-collision - u duul gidaarada natiijo la'aan.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.name: Qaab Jilicsan
power.neoorigins.elytrian_fragile.descri: Lafaha shimbiraha madhan - laba qalbi oo ka yar.
power.neoorigins.elytrian_no_heavy_armor: Ma xiran karo birta, dahabka, dheemanka, ama hubka netherite - maqaar iyo silsilad kaliya.Baalashu waa inay iftiin noqdaan.
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.name: Ku shaabadeeyey
power.neoorigins.strider_stampede.descri: Horey ugu dallac lugaha qaro weyn.Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 adkeysi4-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.name: Dhulka Slam
power.neoorigins.golem_ground_slam.descr: Dhulka ku dhufo feedh bir ah - 4 dhaawac iyo gaabis II 4 ilbiriqsi dhammaan cadawga u dhow ee raadiyaha 5-block ah.Waxay ku kacaysaa 3 adkeysi7-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.enderian_ender_eyes.des: Endermen waxay iska indhatiraan aragtidaada - u fiirso iyaga adoon kicin.
power.neoorigins.enderian_projectile_dod: 50% fursad aad teleefanka kaga fogaato oo aad ka fogaato dhaawac marka uu ku dhaco madfaca.
power.neoorigins.enderian_water_damage.d: Waxay ku qaadataa 2 dhaawac ilbiriqsi kasta marka ay taabtaan biyaha ama roobka.
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.name: Daba-dheeraada
power.neoorigins.enderian_teleport.descr: Taleefoon u dir meesha aad ka raadinayso - ilaa 50 baloog.Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 tamar3-labaad qaboojin.
Ku dheggan meel kasta oo toosan - ku dheji gidaar si aad u qabsato, u bood si aad u fuulid, qabso dhuumasho si aad meesha ugu sii jirto.Burburka dhicista waa laga fogaadaa marka la qabsanayo.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_affinit: Wuxuu dhex maraa shabkada cob-ka ah adoon la gaabin oo isla markiiba jebiya.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_entity_group.d: Waxa loo tiriyaa sidii arthropod - waxyeelo dheeraad ah oo ka soo gaadhay hubka Bane of Arthropods.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_spiders_fang.d: Weerarrada Melee waxay duraan sunta - bartilmaameedyadu waxay la kulmaan Sun I ilaa 3 ilbiriqsi.
power.neoorigins.arachnid_cobweb_project: Waxay ku tuurtaa shabag-goboleedka iskeed u saarta saamaynta, oo ku xidha wax kasta oo ay ku soo degto.Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 tamar
power.neoorigins.shulk_natural_armor.des: Iska caabinta Joogtada ah I - qoloftu waxay nuugtaa dharbaaxooyin dildilaacaya jidh jilicsan.
power.neoorigins.shulk_slow_movement.des: U dhaqaaqa si ka gaabis ah sidii caadiga ahayd.
Fir fircoon: sii daaya dillaaca qolofka levitation - cadawga u dhow ayaa kor u sabbaynaya ilaa 3 sekan.Waxay ku kacaysaa 2 adkeysi8-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.shulk_shell_retreat.des: Firfircoon: ku dhex lun qolofkaaga oo dib uga soo kac ilaa 12 baloog.Waxay ku kacaysaa 3 adkeysi10-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.shulk_levitation_immuni: Ka difaaca levitation - qolofkaaga ayaa ku ilaalinaya xididka marka ay xabbaduhu soo noqdaan.
power.neoorigins.phantom_night_vision.de: Waxa uu si cad wax uga arki karaa gudcurka guud.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.phantom_water_breathing: Uma baahna inuu neefsado.Wuxuu ku noolaan karaa ilaa xad aan xad lahayn.
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.name: Foomka Phantom
power.neoorigins.phantom_form.descriptio: Noqo mid aan la arki karin oo si miisaan la'aan ah u leexda.
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.name: Baalasha Spectral
power.neoorigins.phantom_flight.descript: U lul sida isticmaale elytra - shay looma baahna.Riix bood markaad u dhacayso si aad u kala bixiso baalashaada.
power.neoorigins.phantom_elytra_boost.de: Wuxuu helay xawaare aad u jaban marka la duulayo - phantoms waxay si adag u fuulaan baalashooda.
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.name: Dayax-gacmeed
power.neoorigins.phantom_moon_armor.desc: Iska caabin I oo ka hooseeya dayaxa (habeen kaliya) - iftiinka dayaxu wuxuu daboolaa qaabka muuqaalka.Iftiinka dharaartu waxay kaxaysaa ilaalinta.
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.name: Qulqulka Nafta
power.neoorigins.phantom_soul_drain.desc: Bogsii 1 HP mar kasta oo aad disho noole.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.name: Miisaan la'aan
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_fall.descrip: Wax dhaawac ah oo dhicis ah ma geysto - maydadka rooxaantu ma soo degaan.
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.name: Qorraxda
power.neoorigins.phantom_sunburn.descrip: Dab qabta oo 1.5 waxyeelo u geysta ilbiriqsikiiba iftiinka qoraxda ee tooska ah.
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.name: Foomka Jilicsan
power.neoorigins.phantom_fragile.descrip: -2 wadnaha (-4 max HP).Jirka ceeryaamo way fududahay in la tuuro.
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.name: Hurdo La'aan Cabsi
power.neoorigins.phantom_no_sleep.descri: Ma seexan karo - habeenku waa curiyahaaga.
origins.neoorigins.feline.name: Cawska
origins.neoorigins.feline.description: Bisad degdeg ah oo leh aragti habeennimo oo aad u boodboodaysa - cagahooda ku soo degaya, way dhaafaan yeyda iyo yeeyga, laakiin way neceb yihiin biyaha oo si degdeg ah ugu gubanaya.
power.neoorigins.feline_no_fall_damage.d: Had iyo jeer u deg si nabad ah.Ma qaado waxyeelo dhicid
power.neoorigins.feline_night_vision.des: Si cad wax u arki kara gudcurka dhexdiisa.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.name: Firfircoon
power.neoorigins.feline_speed_boost.desc: 10% ka dhaqso badan qofka caadiga ah.
power.neoorigins.feline_mobs_ignore.name: Degganaanta Ugaadha
